card.name: Product-type noun after a modifier
card.fires_on: A generic noun naming a kind of product or item (tablets, preparations, formulations, PCB, document) right after a drug, material or thing name that modifies it. The noun is usually the head of a noun phrase and the next words continue the description.

modes.label: Dosage-form nouns
modes.description: Tablets, preparations or formulations following a drug or ingredient name.

modes.label: Technical noun after modifier
modes.description: A noun like PCB or document after a describing word in technical or web text.
